headline: Names a Postal Service building in Mastic, New York, after Army Specialist Thomas J. Wilwerth.
what_it_does: This law renames the United States Postal Service facility at 1450 Montauk Highway in Mastic, New York, as the Army Specialist Thomas J. Wilwerth Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, staffing, and postal rules stay the same.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 21, 2019, and the designation took effect on that date.
